intended_use: Credential-free validation of bounded AWS career portfolio templates; no running workloads or deployment authority.

template-tests.scope: Synthetic-account CDK templates, exact trust/image-policy boundaries and deliberately invalid template controls

synthesis.scope: Strict local synthesis and cdk-nag; context lookups disabled, no AWS calls or deployment

deployment-controls.scope: Mocked GitHub API/context controls for exact-revision manual deployment evidence; no provider or actual GitHub call

acceptance_criteria: Offline template behavior and types satisfy the bounded sandbox requirements.
gaps: Synthetic templates are checked; deployed AWS behavior is not observed.
correctness.next_check: Review exact synthesized artifacts before any separately authorized manual deployment.

acceptance_criteria: Generated publisher trust binds exact repository, audience and environment; image mutation stays repository-scoped.
gaps: Actual GitHub environment approval, deployed IAM and cloud-side denial are external evidence.
security.next_check: Independently verify deployed trust and environment protections under operator authority.

acceptance_criteria: Local synthesis and policy controls execute within bounded CI timeouts.
gaps: Deployment retry, interruption and rollback have not been exercised.
reliability.next_check: Run an approved disposable deployment recovery exercise before relying on operational recovery.

acceptance_criteria: The sandbox must not introduce running workloads or user-data resources.
gaps: No database or user-data restore is exercised; deployment artifacts still require provenance review.
data_integrity.next_check: Confirm any future stateful resource has an independently tested restore plan.

acceptance_criteria: Synthesized task logs have bounded retention and cost notifications are declared.
gaps: Delivery of live logs, budget alerts and anomaly notifications is not verified by templates.
observability.next_check: Observe operator-approved notification delivery and retained audit artifacts.

acceptance_criteria: Frozen dependency installation, actual validation and complete eight-dimension evidence precede any delivery claim.
gaps: CI evidence is scoped to source/templates; only a human approves and performs deployment.
delivery.next_check: Review exact-head CI artifacts and retain the existing human deployment boundary.

acceptance_criteria: The manual-only protected-environment deployment and documented rollback boundary remain required.
gaps: No deployment, operator approval, rollback or cloud inventory operation is performed by validation.
operations.next_check: Follow the operator runbook only under separate explicit deployment authority.

acceptance_criteria: Portfolio claims distinguish inert demonstration infrastructure from running product traffic or customer outcomes.
gaps: No customer use, revenue or deployed cost outcome is measured.
outcome_evidence.next_check: Collect independently attributable portfolio/use evidence without treating synthetic checks as customer proof.
